voices.name: Joanna – Warm & Conversational
voices.script: You must be the new guest. Upstairs, then. You'll find the kettle by the window. Mind the third step. It makes a noise like a dying goose.

voices.name: Brodie – Breezy & Genuine
voices.script: Tell me what happened. Hold still, menace. Yes. That's the treatment. All doctors do it.
